nodes.long_description:
# VR Lawn Bowls: Own the Green

Step onto the green in **virtual reality** and feel every delivery. Read the line, fight the wind, and chase the perfect end across Singles, Pairs, Triples, and Fours.

# Beat the Best

Five AI difficulty levels stand between you and glory, from a gentle warm-up to a pro who punishes loose bowls.

# Bring Your Friends

Jump into remote games with names, avatars, and **voice chat** with live speaking indicators. Weather, wet green patches, and auto-bowl settings stay in sync, so every player faces the same green.

# The Green Fights Back

Wind bends your line, rain slickens the surface, and wet patches drag your bowl short. Dial in rink length, pick your rink, or unleash **Free Mode** with no boundary, any mat position, and total jack freedom.

# Bowl Your Way

Tracked hands and fingers, or a **bowling arm** for supported delivery. The **aim guide** maps your line, bias width runs from Straight to Unreasonably Wide, and the **B button** flips bias on the fly.

Six bowl patterns, team colour rings, and rank markers let you bowl in style.

# Learn Fast

The **tutorial system** gets you bowling in minutes, while the wrist UI shows the current head and hands you auto-bowl controls tuned to your speed and angle.

# Built for Quest

Dynamic resolution, higher refresh rates, and settings that stick between sessions. Your game saves after every bowl.

Think you can hold the shot? The green is waiting.
nodes.short_description: Step onto the green in VR and master lawn bowls. Read the line, fight wind and rain, and chase the perfect end across Singles, Pairs, Triples, and Fours. Face five AI levels from beginner to pro, or team up online with player avatars and voice chat. Dial in rink length, switch on Free Mode, and bowl your way with tracked hands, a bowling arm, and an aim guide. Six patterns, team colour rings, rank markers, and a full tutorial. Your game saves after every bowl. Think you can hold the shot?

nodes.long_description:
# VR Lawn Bowls – Step Onto the Green

Experience the sport of **lawn bowls** like never before in immersive **virtual reality**! Perfect your delivery, read the green, and challenge yourself across multiple game modes and skill levels.

---

# Smarter AI, Bigger Challenges

Take on **five levels of AI difficulty**—from beginner to pro—each offering unique strategies and shot precision. Whether you’re learning or looking for a serious test, there’s always a challenge waiting.

---

# Game Modes for Every Style

Play solo or team up in:
- **Singles** – One-on-one duels  
- **Pairs** – Tactical two-player matches  
- **Triples** – Team play with three  
- **Fours** – Full four-player strategy  

---

# Built for Meta Quest

With intuitive VR controls, realistic physics, and detailed greens, you’ll feel like you're right on the green. Just grab your controllers and bowl.

---

# Features

- 5 AI difficulty levels (Beginner to Pro)  
- Singles, Pairs, Triples, and Fours modes  
- Realistic throwing mechanics  
- Immersive audio and environments  
- Designed for Meta Quest headsets

---

Are you ready to become a VR bowls champion?
nodes.short_description: Step onto the green and experience the ultimate VR lawn bowls challenge! Compete in singles, pairs, triples, or fours against lifelike AI opponents across five skill levels—from beginner to pro. Precision, strategy, and immersive gameplay await. Are you ready to bowl like a champion?

nodes.change_log:
# Release Notes

## v0.10.6 - 7 October 2026

### Added
- Voice activity indicators so you can see which players are speaking in multiplayer games
- Weather and surface moisture now sync across all players in multiplayer games
- Caps lock now turns on automatically for the multiplayer join code keyboard

### Changed
- Bowls and jacks now slow down more on the wetter parts of the green

### Fixed
- Free Mode mat not rotating to face the jack in multiplayer games
- Controllers not driving hand and finger movement in multiplayer games
- Avatar mouths not moving when players speak in multiplayer games

## v0.10.5 - 24 September 2026

### Added
- Player names and avatars now display correctly for every player in multiplayer games
- Auto-bowl controls on the wrist UI, with speed and angle preferences that sync across players

### Changed
- Bowl and jack camera tracking now runs locally, removing per-frame network traffic
- Error reports now respect the data collection opt-out setting

### Fixed
- Clients not being disconnected or removed from the session when the host disconnects
- Leaving clients being replaced with AI
- Game being locked when a client leaves during their turn
- Clients not being sent back to the menu area after leaving a game
- Players being added to the game voice channel if they disconnect while joining
- Player list and player dropdowns not updating correctly in multiplayer rooms
- Clients who left or closed the app before the game started not being removed
- Newly joined clients not being picked up by a host returning from low power
- Jack, coin and scoreboard not displaying correctly when a client rejoins an active game
- Multiplayer objects and UI falling back to single player behaviour while a client reconnects
- A player's bowl not resetting when dropped on the mat
- Touched bowls in the ditch being removed incorrectly
- Dead bowl detection for bowls outside the rink, in the ditch, and short bowls
- Jack ownership not returning to the first delivering team after an incorrect delivery
- Distance circles not updating when the jack is repositioned
- Bowl spawn angle not accounting for a rotated mat in Free Mode
- Coin flip animation not playing due to a stale current end value
- Opening coin remaining visible after the first end started
- Wrist displays not following the controller or hiding with it
- Wrist settings toggles only hiding the toggle instead of the whole labelled row
- Rink boundary showing in non-regular game modes
- Voice chat volume adjustments not using the joined channel
- Scoreboard end text not clearing between ends
- Single player names not being remembered in the create game menu

## v0.10.4 - 22 May 2026

### Added
- Club logo wall to clubrooms

## v0.10.3 - 12 May 2026

### Added
- Dynamic resolution support
- "B" button in-game to change bias direction

### Fixed
- Bowl drop ending player's turn incorrectly
- Interaction bug with the new mat
